name: nf-return-filing
description: Establish selected Norfolk Island annual income-tax return obligations for the 2026 return year and distinguish them from 2026-27 planning. Use for filing thresholds, low income, losses, companies, partnerships, child support, non-lodgment advice, substituted accounting periods, agent extensions, further-return notices and declarations. Covers the annual instruments, ordinary deadline and business-day adjustment, approved forms, payment separation and fictional boundary examples. Requires the actual taxpayer, period, complete trigger and exception screening, notice and confirmed due-date evidence. Preserves applicable workflow outputs and holds actual returns, specialised entity cases, penalty calculations and unresolved facts. This source-cited reference does not complete the compliance or country pack.
